main.label: The shrunk stair range stopped the munchkin climb
main.explanation: A level-5 munchkin Warrior at depth 10 has a known up staircase five grids away. The base stair-search range is 8, but the "increase the range" adjustment adds (clevel - 10) + (10 - depth), which is negative below level 10: the range shrinks to 3, no staircase counts as close, and the borg never power-climbs toward the stairs it can see - it falls back to the generic any-stair flow. The correction gates the adjustment on clevel > 10, restoring the base range, and the climb decision fires.

clevel11.label: Control: level-11 Borg, range really grows
clevel11.explanation: Munchkin mode only runs below maximum level 12, so level 11 is the one level above the gate. The adjustment adds (11-10)+(10-10)=1 (range 9) in both versions, and the staircase is 8 grids away: only the grown range counts it as close (8 < 9), so both versions power-climb.
